overall: The AG found the Wayland School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law on both allegations (thin July 2014 executive session minutes and an undisclosed subject before the August 2014 session), but ordered no further relief because the committee acknowledged the errors, amended the minutes, agreed to training, and pledged compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the minutes of the July 30, 2014 executive session were insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: Following our review, we resolve this complaint by informal action in accordance with 940 CMR 29.07(2)(a), and find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law in the ways alleged in the complaint.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that before the August 28, 2014 executive session the committee failed to publicly disclose a subject discussed in it.
